title: Completed affine coherent pullback objects
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, $f:X\to Y$ proper, $G$ a coherent formal $J$-system and $F$ coherent on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-module-pullback]. For an affine open $U$ set $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$, and assume $R$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $g:S\to Y$ the completion map followed by the inverse affine chart and inclusion, and $Z=X\times_Y S$ with projections $q:Z\to X$ and $p:Z\to S$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $J_0$ be the ideal sheaf of $J(U)R$, transported by the inverse Spec global-sections isomorphism. Then $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], $J.\operatorname{comap}(g)=J_0$, and there exist $G_0\in\operatorname{Coh}(S,J_0)$ and coherent $F_0$ on $Z$, with $D=p_*F_0$ coherent, such that the underlying diagrams satisfy $G_0=G\mathbin\circ g^*$ and the underlying modules satisfy $F_0=q^*F$. No adjunction comparison or maps of formal systems are asserted.

proof.text: The affine section ring B is Noetherian, so its adic completion is flat by AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian. Flat.SpecMap_iff and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff give the flat completion Spec map, and composition with the affine chart and inclusion remains flat. On affine top sections ideal_top_comap_specMap_fromSpec and ideal_top_ofIdealTop give equality of the extended ideal with J₀; ext_of_isAffine upgrades it to ideal-sheaf equality.

Noetherian S and proper base change give Noetherian Z, and proper f over Noetherian Y gives Noetherian X. Apply exists_formalSystemsPullback along g and rewrite by the ideal equality to obtain its formal-system functor P; apply it along q to obtain the coherent-module functor C. Congruence of the supplied functor equalities at G and F proves (P.obj G).obj=G.obj⋙g* and (C.obj F).obj=q*F.obj.

For the coherent module C.obj F on Noetherian Z, coherence gives quasi-coherence; its affine sections are finite. Noetherian rings turn these finite modules into finitely presented modules; the affine finite-presentation criterion and coversTop give finite presentation of the sheaf. Apply isFinitePresentation_higherDirectImage p F₀.obj 0 and rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf to obtain finite presentation of p_*F₀. Quasi-coherence of proper pushforward and finite presentation imply the quasi-coherent finite-type coherence criterion on S. Package the two functor objects, coherence, their equality proofs, flatness, and ideal equality.

lean.statement: theorem completedAffine_pullback_objects {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X) (U : Y.affineOpens) [IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) Γ(Y, U.1))] : let B := Γ(Y, U.1) let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of R) let I := (J.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R) let J₀ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom) let g : S ⟶ Y := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B R)) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι let Z := pullback f g let p : Z ⟶ S := pullback.snd f g ∃ (G₀ : CoherentFormalModule S J₀) (F₀ : CoherentModules Z) (_hD : RingedSpace.IsCoherent S.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj)), G₀.obj = G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g ∧ F₀.obj = (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F.obj ∧ Flat g ∧ J.comap g = J₀
